summary: Defines a way for a mobile node to identify itself by including its Network Access Identifier in the Mobile IP registration request. It also updates RFC 2290 for the Mobile-IPv4 option in IPCP. It is a standards-track document at the proposed standard level.

eli5.summary: A traveling device shows a name tag when it signs in on a new network, so the home network knows it.

questions: how does a mobile node identify itself
